obs: "But turning our attention from this view of the subject, and looking at the statute alone, and reading it by its own light, we entertain no doubt that it made the company liable to suit"

"Though that is quite true, we do not sit to determine what Congress ought to have done given the evidence before it, but to apply what Congress enacted and, as we have discussed, the exclusion of short-term miners from the benefits of the presumption finds no support in the statute."
